title: Gaius Welcomes Workers While Diotrephes Rejects Them
summary_text: The elder rejoices that Gaius lives by the truth and faithfully helps traveling brothers, even those he did not know. These workers went out for the Name without support from Gentiles, so helping them makes believers partners in the truth. Diotrephes seeks first place, rejects the elder's instruction, spreads slander, and drives out people who welcome the brothers. The elder urges Gaius to imitate good rather than evil and commends Demetrius's trustworthy reputation. He hopes to visit soon and speak face to face.
